name: Matte Dimensional Anime
description: 2Dアニメを基礎にしつつ、3Dアニメ寄りの明確な立体感・奥行き・面のボリュームを優先する。人物・物体・背景を平面的に処理せず、光と影で形状と空間を明確に分離する。表面はマットで、強い光沢や実写的な肌質、PBR的な質感は避ける。
medium: 2D anime foundation with pronounced 3D-anime-like dimensionality and volumetric form

shading.style: strong dimensional anime shading with smooth volumetric gradients and readable form planes
shading.facial_planes: soft but clearly modeled cheeks, nose, jaw, and eye sockets

lighting.form_priority: lighting must describe volume and separate planes

materials.skin: smooth matte anime skin with modeled volume, no photoreal skin texture
materials.hair: dimensional anime hair masses with controlled highlights and visible strand grouping
materials.fabric: matte fabric with readable folds and volume, not PBR

depth.target: clear 3D-anime-like volume while remaining stylized anime
depth.scene_layers: clear foreground, subject, midground, and background separation

background.rendering: same dimensional visual world as foreground
background.depth: clear foreground-midground-background separation with readable perspective
background.detail: avoid watercolor wash; keep forms spatially defined

prompt.positive: Matte Dimensional Anime, stylized anime with pronounced 3D-anime-like dimensionality, strong dimensional form, clear volumetric shading, modeled facial planes, visible volume in cheeks nose jaw neck arms torso and legs, soft cinematic lighting that describes form, soft global-illumination-like fill, matte surface response, restrained specular highlights, clear spatial depth, strong foreground subject midground background separation, cinematic spatial depth, clean dimensional anime rendering
prompt.negative: photorealistic, live-action, realistic human skin texture, glossy CGI, plastic-like CGI, PBR materials, excessive specular highlights, waxy skin, flat anime shading, flat cel shading, flat facial planes, flat composition, watercolor illustration, painterly wash, sketch-like rendering, washed-out depth, weak volumetric shading, overly soft undefined forms
